limits: This records predeployment evidence at the old production revision; repeat scoped current checks after exact-image deployment.
Tunnel status, application readiness and provider incident relevance remain separate observations.
The published route and independent HTTP response support a request-path dependency candidate; they do not prove continuous user availability or provider causation.
Edge connection labels are not incident geography, and no geographic wildcard is inferred.
A normal host Caddyfile read was permission-denied; its internal reverse-proxy directive was not inspected or inferred by that read, and the denial was not bypassed.
Account IDs, tunnel/replica IDs, origin IP, connector hostname, raw inventory and credentials are excluded from this public receipt.
Console observations are root-recorded, not independently replayed by a static reviewer.
